questions.question: The new policy, which has been under discussion for months, was finally approved by the board yesterday.
options: It was the new policy that had been under discussion.
Which has been under discussion is the new policy.
The new policy, being under discussion for months, was finally approved yesterday.
That the new policy has been under discussion for months was finally approved yesterday.
questions.answer: It was the new policy that had been under discussion.

questions.question: If I were you, I would not have invested in that company.
options: I wouldn't have invested if I were you.
You should not have invested in that company.
If I were to invest in a company, it wouldn't be that one.
You wouldn't have invested if I had been you.
questions.answer: I wouldn't have invested if I were you.

questions.question: It is essential that the manager should inform the team about the changes.
options: The manager must inform the team about the changes.
It's essential for the manager to inform the team about the changes.
That the manager informs the team about the changes is essential.
The manager being informed of the changes is essential.
questions.answer: The manager must inform the team about the changes.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had already eaten dinner.
options: I had arrived by the time they had eaten dinner.
They had eaten dinner before I arrived.
When I arrived, they were eating dinner.
It was when I arrived that they had eaten dinner.
questions.answer: They had eaten dinner before I arrived.

questions.question: What is it that makes you think the company will go bankrupt?
options: What do you think will make the company go bankrupt?
It's what makes me think the company will go bankrupt.
I wonder what would make the company go bankrupt.
It's not clear to me what makes you think the company will go bankrupt.
questions.answer: What is it that makes you think the company will go bankrupt?
